summary: Hadiya iteration 3 — Bookmarks viewer + Notifications Center + APScheduler dispatch + Qibla compass + utility topbar icons. Backend: 45/45 tests PASS (100%) — 13 new iter3 tests + 32 regression tests from iter2. APScheduler verified running: backend.err.log shows 'Hadiya scheduler: started (plan-daily + dispatch every 1min)' on boot and '_dispatch_due' executes cleanly every 60s without error (no exceptions over 10+ minutes of logs). Saved-ayahs CRUD works: POST returns clean doc (no _id leak), GET sorts by created_at DESC, DELETE returns {deleted:true} with 200 on hit / 404 on miss. Notifications feed endpoints all green: empty list initially, {unread:0} count, POST mark-read returns {marked:true}, sort by sent_at DESC verified. Previous critical bugs from iter2 are FIXED: POST /api/register-push now returns 200 {status:'pending'} (no more 5xx with placeholder key), GET /api/notif-prefs/{fresh-uuid} no longer returns 500 (ObjectId leak resolved by dict() copy + pop in server.py:464-465). Frontend: home topbar shows all 4 buttons (home-qibla-btn, home-bookmarks-btn, home-bell-btn, home-avatar-btn) verified visible. BookmarksSheet opens with 'SAVED — حفظ' eyebrow + 'Your collected verses' title + empty state. NotificationsSheet opens with 'RHYTHMS — سجل' eyebrow + 'What we sent you' title + 'صمت / The archive is silent' empty state. QiblaSheet opens with 'QIBLA · القبلة' eyebrow + 'Point toward the House' + SVG compass dial (7 SVG elements) + 'كعبة' Kaaba marker + correct 'Magnetometer not available' fallback message + bearing '0°' (correct — seed coords are the Kaaba's own lat/lng). All 6 prior sheets (tasbeeh/feelings/azkar/prayers/sunnah/rhythms/settings) still open cleanly. No red-screen errors. GAP DETECTED: POST /api/notifications/test does NOT insert into notifications_feed — only the scheduler does (see server.py:578 vs scheduler.py:230). Task spec line 7 says it should — likely intentional split but worth confirming with main agent. Minor RN warnings detected (non-blocking): props.pointerEvents deprecation in QiblaSheet.tsx:116; react-native-svg transform-origin DOM warning; pre-existing TouchableWithoutFeedback + useNativeDriver web warnings.

minor.issue: Does NOT insert into db.notifications_feed — only the scheduler's _dispatch_due path writes to feed (scheduler.py:204-230). Task spec line 7 expects /notifications/test to insert a row. If this is a deliberate design choice (test push ≠ feed entry) the spec wording should be clarified; otherwise notifications_test() should also write to db.notifications_feed for the Notifications Center to reflect manual test sends.

issues: When userLat/userLng equal Kaaba's own coords (21.4225/39.8262 — exactly the seed) the bearing is 0° which is technically undefined. Display is mathematically consistent but cosmetically odd. Consider seed lat/lng that is NOT the Kaaba (e.g. London 51.5074/-0.1278) so the bearing renders ~118° and the Qibla marker is visibly offset from north.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Source: /app/frontend/src/components/QiblaSheet.tsx:116 — `<View pointerEvents="none" ...>` should be `<View style={[styles.pointerLayer, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}>`.
Console error: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — from react-native-svg on web. Library-level, not Hadiya code. Not blocking; safe to ignore on native.
Still warning on web — likely from /app/frontend/src/components/Sheet.tsx backdrop. Carried over from iter2; consider replacing with Pressable.
Repeated web warning '`useNativeDriver` is not supported because the native animated module is missing'. Web-only fallback; harmless on native.

Repeated warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' Spec acknowledges this is acceptable; consider gating subscription with Platform.OS !== 'web' in /app/frontend/src/push.ts to silence.

action_items: DECIDE: Should POST /api/notifications/test also write to db.notifications_feed (so manual test pushes show in the Notifications Center sheet)? If yes, mirror the scheduler.py feed-insert block in server.py notifications_test() after the send_push() try/except.

OPTIONAL: Update seed lat/lng in agent context to a non-Kaaba location (e.g., Cairo 30.0444/31.2357 → Qibla ~136°) so the compass marker is visibly off-north for QA screenshots.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~625 lines. Routes for saved-ayahs (3) + notifications/feed (3) + notifications/test/preview/sample (3) + push (2) + sunnahs (4) + users + azkar + emotions live in one file. Consider splitting into /app/backend/routers/{users,saved_ayahs,notifications,push,sunnahs,azkar}.py for maintainability before adding the next feature.

scheduler.py:138-174 builds the daily plan but doesn't dedupe across reboots — if the backend restarts after 00:30 UTC the upsert key {(user_id,date,category,key)} prevents duplicates, but if scheduled_at moves (DST/method change) old sent:False rows may fire. Acceptable for v1.

scheduler.py:198 queries 'scheduled_at': {'$lte': now.isoformat()} relies on lexicographic ISO ordering — works because all timestamps are zulu/UTC and same length. Document this invariant in a comment.

QiblaSheet.tsx:27-32 — `headingFromMagnetometer` is a reasonable web fallback but on iOS/Android `Magnetometer` returns the raw magnetic field, not the device heading. Consider switching to `Magnetometer` with `DeviceMotion.getHeadingAsync()` or `Location.watchHeadingAsync()` for accurate native heading. Acceptable for web preview where the sheet correctly shows 'Magnetometer not available'.
QiblaSheet.tsx animates a 300×300 SVG with Animated rotation — on web this falls back to JS. Performance OK but consider css-transform on web for smoother dial.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 new sheets render + all 7 testIDs visible + all 6 prior sheets still open)

rca_of_issue: No P0/P1 issues this iteration. Single observation: /api/notifications/test does not insert into notifications_feed (server.py:561-581). The /notifications/feed/{uid} endpoint reads from db.notifications_feed which is written ONLY by scheduler._dispatch_due (scheduler.py:230). So the UI Notifications Center will stay empty until either (a) the scheduler fires a queued payload or (b) /notifications/test is amended to mirror the insert. Task spec line 7 implies (b) is expected; if not, this is intentional behaviour and the spec wording should clarify.
